classic.name: Classic
classic.fact: The original Lunar Lander test site: 10 m/s², no air, no wind.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.fact: No air at all. One day lasts 176 Earth days; 167 °C on average.

venus.name: Venus
venus.fact: Air 92 times thicker than Earth's slows every move; 464 °C.

earth.name: Earth
earth.fact: One bar of air, a breeze, 15 °C on average.

moon.name: Moon
moon.fact: No air, no wind, and a sixth of Earth's gravity.

mars.name: Mars
mars.fact: Thin CO₂ air, 1% of Earth's, with dusty gusts; −65 °C.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.fact: No surface: a pad floats in the cloud tops. Needs a 2.3× engine and sturdy legs.

europa.name: Europa
europa.fact: Jupiter's icy moon. No air, about −160 °C, Jupiter fills the sky.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.fact: No surface: a pad floats above fast, freezing clouds; −140 °C.

titan.name: Titan
titan.fact: Saturn's moon: air 1.5 times thicker than Earth's, gravity weaker than the Moon's.

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.fact: An ice giant tipped on its side by 98°; −195 °C.

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.fact: The fastest winds in the solar system; −200 °C.

pluto.name: Pluto
pluto.fact: A whisper of air, 1/100,000 of Earth's; −225 °C.
